name: Open Graph Benchmark: Drug-Drug Interaction (ogbl-ddi)
description: A drug-drug interaction prediction benchmark represented as an undirected graph: nodes are drugs and edges indicate interactions. The task is link prediction; this record describes the dataset and does not distribute data.
citation: Hu, W., Fey, M., Zitnik, M., Dong, Y., Ren, H., Liu, B., Catasta, M., & Leskovec, J. (2020). Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 33, 22118–22133. https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.00687

license.identifier: Dataset-specific terms (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: The OGB link-property dataset documentation does not specify a standard SPDX license identifier for ogbl-ddi. Review the upstream terms and source-data conditions before use or redistribution. This record is loader-only and vendors no data.
